summary: Super League Enterprise, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its asset purchase of the Misfits Ads Business from Esports Now, LLC. Consideration included $1.5 million cash, 26,768 shares, a pre-funded warrant for 509,682 shares, and a warrant for 536,450 shares at $18.00 exercise price. The transaction was approved by stockholders at a special meeting on April 30, 2026, and closed on May 1, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or breakup fee is disclosed. The stockholder vote was required due to share issuance. Watch for potential dilution from the warrants and integration risks.
